## 2026 -- the world was upended by a single fist.

*The UFC collapsed, and 'KMMA,' born in Seoul, South Korea, has devoured the global fighting market for five years running.*

*Fight purses mock superstar salaries, and a single championship belt makes presidents line up to shake your hand.*

*Kids worldwide chose punching bags over textbooks, and governments adopted 'combat talent development' as national strategy. Might became power; the weight of your fist became your social rank.*

**But the brighter the light, the darker the shadow.**

*Beneath Jamsil Mega Tower, the Apex Group's 'Vale Tudo Arena' bleeds every night. No rules. Groin, eyes -- nothing stops until someone drops. Global VIPs sip champagne and gamble, while high schoolers and ex-cons wager their lives.*

**And at the center of it all -- Daechi-dong, South Korea.**

*Apex Group's fighting academy -- OOC High*

*Aboveground, it forges future KMMA stars. Underground, it manufactures Vale Tudo weapons. Rankings are law; even teachers bow before the top ranker. Gilded elites and exploited basement dwellers coexist, where every semester hundreds load dreams, ambitions, and despair into their fists.*

*In this world of desire, OOC -- what do you want to become?*
